name: Russia–NATO
value: Estonia to shut Russia border from 1 Dec
summary: Estonia will close its Russian border crossings on 1 Dec after a GRU-ordered sabotage plot; Kremlin calls it baseless
state: Estonia's foreign minister said Russia's GRU ordered a foiled arson and explosives attack on drone maker Threod Systems near Tallinn on the night of 14 Nov; eight Latvia-based suspects were detained, and all border crossings with Russia will close on 1 Dec (The Moscow Times; Kyiv Post). On 16 Nov Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov called the accusations entirely baseless. No Article 4 request, clash or attack on NATO territory was found as of 17 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Estonia's road crossings with Russia are due to close from 1 Dec, with no end date set. Check FCDO travel advice for Estonia and Russia before crossing borders in the region.
rubric_hit: Sabotage attributed to Russia (GRU, Estonia, 14 Nov) = Watch; no Article 4 or attack on NATO territory
